runtime_metadata.name: alakazam_ml_v6
runtime_metadata.model: LightGBM candidate ranker distilled to pure Python trees
runtime_metadata.model_scope: Shadow-scored ACTIVE MAIN ranking over guarded bench, evolution, and attack candidates. Deterministic fallback remains authoritative unless ALAKAZAM_ML_ENABLE_OVERRIDE=1 is explicitly set for an experiment.
runtime_metadata.deck_policy: 60-card v6 revision: 3 Dunsparce / 3 Dudunsparce, 2 basic Psychic, 4 Telepath Psychic, Fezandipiti ex, Max Rod ACE, Boss's Orders 3, no Genesect/Lucky Helmet/Shaymin/Psyduck

ladder_fix_basis.source: 92 v5 Kaggle ladder replays from submissions 54788067 and 54795292
rules: never activate Dudunsparce when it is the only Pokemon in play
replace Genesect, Lucky Helmet, and one basic Psychic Energy with three Boss's Orders
play Boss only when it creates a same-turn KO on a strategically superior Bench target
prioritize Team Rocket's Articuno and effect-protection engines when they are KO-able
never replace an equal or better Active KO with a lower-value Bench KO
retrain the shadow ranker on the same 92 replays without granting live override authority
